system.biography:
Goddess of Righteous Ideals and Heavenly Duty, primary operator of the Dirigible Engine Daystar. Madly loyal to the Unconquered Sun. Takes the form of a beautiful orichalcum-skinned woman with full hair, flame red in the dark and violet in the day, wearing armored dress and kimono. Carries a tower shield of bronze and a massive white jade dire lance.

Source: Glories of the Most High: The Unconquered Sun.
